CREATE VIEW [dye].[A_PTGX]
AS

SELECT 
*
FROM 
(SELECT 
C.*,
CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),DATEADD(hh,-8,C.StartTime),120)RQ,
DATEADD(hh,0,C.StartTime)AS RQDate,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(C.NUM,0)=0,1,1.00/C.NUM)*C.CurrKg)SK_Qty
FROM 
(SELECT 
COUNT(A.EmpID)OVER (PARTITION BY A.WProcessNo ORDER BY A.WProcessNo)NUM,
A.JobSheetNo,
A.ShiftID,
A.EmpID,
A.ProcessNo,
A.ProcessID,
A.WProcessNo,
B.ClassID,
B.StationID,
B.MachineID,
B.CurrRolls,
B.CurrKg,
B.Creater,
B.CreateDate,
B.StartTime,
B.EndTime
FROM dye.JobShiftEmp A
LEFT JOIN dye.WProcess B ON B.WProcessNo = A.WProcessNo
WHERE 1=1
AND B.StationID<>'06'
AND ISNULL(B.SheetStatus,0)<>9
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.h_Leave L WHERE A.EmpID=L.EmpID AND 
B.StartTime>L.BeginDate AND B.StartTime<L.EndDate)
)C 
)D

CREATE VIEW [dye].[Order_Jobsheet]
AS
	
SELECT 
js.SheetNo,
js.CurrProcessID,
js.SumAssignedWeightQty,
js.CheckNo,
js.CombineQty,
js.SumCombineQty,
js.ProcessIDName,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),IIF(ISNULL(js.SumCombineQty,0)=0,NULL,js.CombineQty/js.SumCombineQty*js.SumAssignedWeightQty))AS SemiOrderWeightQty,
CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdIn WHERE jobSheetNo=js.SheetNo AND SheetKind=11)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdIn WHERE jobSheetNo=js.SheetNo AND SheetKind=16)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdLoadingDetail pld  LEFT JOIN dye.ProdLoading pl ON pl.SheetSeries = pld.SheetSeries WHERE pld.JobSheetNo=js.SheetNo AND pl.RightStatus=10 ) THEN '成品入库' 
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdIn WHERE jobSheetNo=js.SheetNo AND SheetKind=16)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdLoadingDetail pld  LEFT JOIN dye.ProdLoading pl ON pl.SheetSeries = pld.SheetSeries WHERE pld.JobSheetNo=js.SheetNo AND pl.RightStatus=10 ) 
 THEN '退车间回修'
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdLoadingDetail pld  LEFT JOIN dye.ProdLoading pl ON pl.SheetSeries = pld.SheetSeries WHERE pld.JobSheetNo=js.SheetNo AND pl.RightStatus=10 ) THEN 
 '已出货' ELSE ISNULL(js.ProcessIDName,js.CurrProcessID)  END AS CurrStatus
FROM 
(SELECT 
A.SheetNo,
A.CurrProcessID,
A.SumAssignedWeightQty,
B.CheckNo,
B.CombineQty,
SUM(B.CombineQty) OVER (PARTITION BY A.SheetSeries ORDER BY A.SheetSeries)AS SumCombineQty,
P.Name AS ProcessIDName
FROM dye.JobCombineOrder B
LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet A ON A.SheetSeries = B.SheetSeries
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Process P ON P.ProcessID=A.CurrProcessID
WHERE 1=1
AND A.JobSheetType=0
AND A.SumAssignedWeightQty>0
)js

CREATE VIEW [dye].[RKLimit]
AS
	SELECT 
    E.CustomerID,
    E.ShortName,
    SUM(E.CurrentNotWriteOffMoney)CurrentNotWriteOffMoney,
    SUM(E.NextMonthNotWriteOffMoney)NextMonthNotWriteOffMoney
	FROM 
	(SELECT
	'C'AS PaymentDay,
	D.CustomerID,
	D.ShortName,
    D.NotWriteOffMoney AS CurrentNotWriteOffMoney,
	CONVERT(DECIMAL(12,2),NULL)  AS NextMonthNotWriteOffMoney
	FROM(
	SELECT 
	C.CustomerID,
	P.ShortName,
	SUM(B.NotWriteOffMoney)NotWriteOffMoney
	FROM (
	SELECT 
	A.ARDetailNo,
	SUM(A.WriteOffMoney)NotWriteOffMoney,
	SUM(A.ARMoney)ARMoney,
	SUM(A.YHWriteOffMoney)YHWriteOffMoney
	FROM (
	SELECT 
	ARDetailNo,
	-WriteOffMoney AS WriteOffMoney,
	0.00 AS ARMoney,
	WriteOffMoney AS YHWriteOffMoney
	FROM  dye.FMoneyInDetail
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
	SheetSeries AS APDetailNo,
	ARMoney AS WriteOffMoney ,
	ARMoney,
	0.00 AS YHWriteOffMoney
	FROM dye.FARMain
	)A
	GROUP BY ARDetailNo
	)B
	LEFT JOIN dye.FARMain C ON B.ARDetailNo=C.SheetSeries
	LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer P ON P.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
	WHERE 
	C.SheetDate<=
	DATEADD(M,-IIF(P.SettleID='01',1,IIF(P.SettleID='02',2,1)),DATEADD(M,DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0))
    GROUP BY C.CustomerID,P.ShortName
	)D
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
	'N'AS PaymentDay,
	D.CustomerID,
	D.ShortName,
    CONVERT(DECIMAL(12,2),NULL) AS CurrentNotWriteOffMoney,
	D.NotWriteOffMoney AS NextMonthNotWriteOffMoney
	FROM(
	SELECT 
	C.CustomerID,
	P.ShortName,
	SUM(B.NotWriteOffMoney)NotWriteOffMoney
	FROM (
	SELECT 
	A.ARDetailNo,
	SUM(A.WriteOffMoney)NotWriteOffMoney,
	SUM(A.ARMoney)ARMoney,
	SUM(A.YHWriteOffMoney)YHWriteOffMoney
	FROM (
	SELECT 
	ARDetailNo,
	-WriteOffMoney AS WriteOffMoney,
	0.00 AS ARMoney,
	WriteOffMoney AS YHWriteOffMoney
	FROM  dye.FMoneyInDetail
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
	SheetSeries AS APDetailNo,
	ARMoney AS WriteOffMoney ,
	ARMoney,
	0.00 AS YHWriteOffMoney
	FROM dye.FARMain
	)A
	GROUP BY ARDetailNo
	)B
	LEFT JOIN dye.FARMain C ON B.ARDetailNo=C.SheetSeries
	LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer P ON P.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
	WHERE 
	C.SheetDate<=
	DATEADD(M,-(IIF(P.SettleID='01',1,IIF(P.SettleID='02',2,1))-1),DATEADD(M,DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE()),0)) 
    GROUP BY C.CustomerID,P.ShortName
	)D
	)E
	GROUP BY E.CustomerID, E.ShortName

select * from

sum(case when a.WareHouseID='12'then b.Amount else 0 end) as 染色领料,
sum(case when a.WareHouseID='13'then b.Amount else 0 end) as 定型领料

group by a.JobSheetNo,a.CombineSheetNos)a

left join (SELECT distinct Batches.BatchNo 缸号,
cast (k.电力耗 as decimal(9,2))电力耗kWh,cast (k.水耗/1000 as decimal(9,2)) 水耗T,cast (k.蒸汽耗 as decimal(9,2))蒸汽耗KG
FROM [192.168.23.254].ccs_erp.dbo.BatchConsValue 
join [192.168.23.254].ccs_erp.dbo.Batches on BatchConsValue.BatchId = Batches.BatchId
left join (select Batches.batchno, 
sum(case when BatchConsDef.Name='电力耗' then BatchConsValue.ConsValue  else 0 end) as 电力耗,
sum(case when BatchConsDef.Name='水耗' then BatchConsValue.ConsValue  else 0 end) as 水耗,
sum(case when BatchConsDef.Name='蒸汽耗' then BatchConsValue.ConsValue else 0 end)  as 蒸汽耗  
from [192.168.23.254].ccs_erp.dbo.BatchConsValue
join [192.168.23.254].ccs_erp.dbo.Batches on BatchConsValue.BatchId = Batches.BatchId
join [192.168.23.254].ccs_erp.dbo.BatchConsDef on BatchConsValue.BatchConsDefId = BatchConsDef.BatchConsDefId 
where Batches.EndTime is not null 
group by Batches.batchno) k on k.batchno=Batches.batchno
where Batches.EndTime is not null ) b on b.缸号=a.JobSheetNo
--定型能耗
left join (select a.Day,a.ShiftID,b.JobSheetNo JobSheetNo1,EndTime,a.RealQty*b.currkg/ISNULL(c.TCURRKG,'0') as 天然气立方 from (
(SELECT a.Day,SUM(a.RealQty)RealQty,ShiftID FROM [TFEMS].dbo.e_DayTimeEnergy a
join dye.p_Meter b on a.MeterID=b.MeterID
join dye.p_Machine c on left(c.Name,1)=left(b.Name,1) and c.Name like'%定%'and c.WorkShopID='06'and c.StationID='03'
where a.Day is not null and b.DeptID='DT004'and a.EnergyKind='40'group by a.Day,ShiftID) a

AS
SELECT  aa.JobSheetNo, aa.ddh AS 订单号, aa.Edge AS 手感编号, aa.NameC AS CusProName, aa.DDYSH, aa.SheetKind, 
                   aa.SheetNo, aa.realrolls AS Rolls, aa.realWeightQty AS WeightQty, aa.realgrayQty AS grayqty, aa.realgrayQty AS gqty, 
                   aa.realLengthQty AS LengthQty, aa.Creater, aa.CreateDate, aa.SheetDate, aa.ProdID, aa.StorageUnitID, aa.ColorNum, 
                   aa.ColorID, aa.AtteFee, aa.VatFee, aa.Area, aa.CustomerID, aa.CustomerID AS kehuname, 
                   (CASE WHEN aa.JobKindID = '01' THEN '正常流程卡' WHEN aa.JobKindID = '02' THEN '客退回修卡' WHEN aa.JobKindID IS NULL
                    THEN '系统导入' ELSE '本厂回修卡' END) AS Jobkind, CASE WHEN aa.customerid IN ('040', '039', '043', '041', '050', '051', 
                   '055', '058') THEN '梭织' ELSE '针织' END AS 布艺类型, 
                   CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull(aa.RSDJ, '0') END AS 染色单价, 
                   CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull(aa.QTDJ, '0') / 1000 END AS 其他收费单价, 
                   CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull(aa.ZGJDDJ, '0') END AS 纸管加胶袋单价, 
                   CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull(aa.SGDJ, '0') END AS 手感单价, 
                   CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull((isnull(aa.RSDJ, '0') + isnull(aa.QTDJ, '0') / 1000 + isnull(aa.SGDJ, 
                   '0')) * aa.realgrayQty, '0') END AS 染整总价, CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull(aa.ZGJDDJ, '0') 
                   * aa.realrolls END AS 纸管加胶袋总价, CASE WHEN aa.JobSheetNo LIKE '%R%' THEN 0 ELSE isnull((isnull(aa.RSDJ, '0') 
                   + isnull(aa.QTDJ, '0') / 1000 + isnull(aa.SGDJ, '0')) * aa.realgrayQty + (isnull(aa.ZGJDDJ, '0') * aa.realrolls), '0') END AS 成品入库总产值, 
                   jobs.Jobattes1, aa.bhd, ISNULL(aa.realWeightQty, 0) - (ISNULL(aa.AtteFee, 0) + ISNULL(aa.VatFee, 0)) * ISNULL(aa.realrolls, 
                   0) AS jingzhong
FROM      (SELECT  CASE WHEN a.rolls < '0' AND a.rolls < pn.Rolls THEN a.rolls ELSE pn.Rolls END AS realrolls, 
                                      CASE WHEN a.rolls < '0' AND a.rolls < pn.Rolls THEN a.WeightQty ELSE pn.WeightQty END AS realWeightQty, 
                                      CASE WHEN a.rolls < '0' AND a.rolls < pn.Rolls THEN a.grayQty ELSE pn.GaryWeight END AS realgrayQty, 
                                      CASE WHEN a.rolls < '0' AND a.rolls < pn.Rolls THEN a.LengthQty ELSE pn.LengthQty END AS realLengthQty, 
                                      a.JobSheetNo, om.SheetNo AS ddh, oc.Edge, p.NameC, pn.SheetKind, pn.SheetNo, j.JobKindID, pn.CustomerID, 
                                      pn.StorageUnitID, oc.Price AS RSDJ, oc.ProcessPrice AS QTDJ, oc.bhd, oae.price AS ZGJDDJ, fod.Price AS SGDJ, 
                                      CASE WHEN om.RightStatus = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DDYSH, pn.Creater, pn.CreateDate, pn.SheetDate, 
                                      pn.ProdID, pn.ColorNum, pn.ColorID, pn.AtteFee, pn.VatFee, pn.Area
                   FROM       (SELECT  a.JobSheetNo, SUM(a.InRolls) AS rolls, SUM(a.InWeightQty) AS WeightQty, SUM(a.InGrayQty) 
                                                          AS grayQty, SUM(a.InLengthQty) AS LengthQty
                                       FROM       dye.ProdStockBook AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                          dye.JobSheet AS j ON a.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                          dye.OrderColor AS oc ON oc.CheckNo = j.CheckNo LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                              (SELECT  SheetSeries, SUM(Price) AS price
                                                               FROM       dye.OrderAtte
                                                               WHERE    (AtteValue LIKE '%胶袋%' OR
                                                                                  AtteValue LIKE '%纸管%') AND (NULLIF (Price, '0') <> '0')
                                                               GROUP BY SheetSeries) AS oae ON oae.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                          dye.FeelOfferDetail AS fod ON fod.FeelCode = oc.Edge AND 
                                                          fod.ProdID = oc.CustFabricName LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                          dye.OrderMain AS om ON om.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                          dye.p_Product AS p ON p.ProdID = j.CustSelfProduct LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                          dye.ProdIn AS pn ON pn.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo AND pn.SheetNo = a.SheetNo
                                       GROUP BY a.JobSheetNo) AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                      dye.ProdIn AS pn ON pn.JobSheetNo = a.JobSheetNo AND pn.SheetKind IN ('10', '11', '16') LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                      dye.JobSheet AS j ON a.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                      dye.OrderColor AS oc ON oc.CheckNo = j.CheckNo LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                          (SELECT  SheetSeries, SUM(Price) AS price
                                           FROM       dye.OrderAtte AS OrderAtte_1
                                           WHERE    (AtteValue LIKE '%胶袋%' OR
                                                              AtteValue LIKE '%纸管%') AND (NULLIF (Price, '0') <> '0')
                                           GROUP BY SheetSeries) AS oae ON oae.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                      dye.FeelOfferDetail AS fod ON fod.FeelCode = oc.Edge AND fod.ProdID = oc.CustFabricName LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                      dye.OrderMain AS om ON om.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                      dye.p_Product AS p ON p.ProdID = j.CustSelfProduct) AS aa LEFT OUTER JOIN
                   dye.JobSheet AS jobs ON jobs.SheetNo = aa.JobSheetNo
WHERE   (1 = 1) AND (aa.SheetKind <> 16)

js.CustomerID,
wp.ShiftID,

select
IsNull(FabricID,'') as FabricID, IsNull(Spec,'')  as Spec, IsNull(Structure,'')  as Structure,

IsNull(Place,'')  as Place,
(case when IsNull(NameType,'') like '%A4%' then (Sum(InQty)-Sum(OutQty)) else 0 end )as A4RemainQty,
(case when  IsNull(NameType,'') like '%样布%' then (Sum(InQty)-Sum(OutQty)) else 0 end )as SampleFabRemainQty,
(case when  IsNull(NameType,'') like '%吊卡%' then (Sum(InQty)-Sum(OutQty)) else 0 end )as WFRemainQty,
IsNull(SalerID,'')  as SalerID,sum(Amount) as Amount,
Sum(InQty) as InQty,Sum(OutQty) as OutQty,Sum(SaveQty) RemainQty
FROM 
(select a.SampleInOutKindID,a.FabricID,a.CustomerID,a.SampleKindID,a.SalerID,Sum(InQty) as InQty,Sum(OutQty) as OutQty,Sum(InQty-OutQty) SaveQty ,sum(Amount) as Amount
from(select SampleInOutKindID,
FabricID,CustomerID,SampleKindID,SalerID,sum(InQty) as InQty ,sum(OutQty) as OutQty,sum(Price) as Amount from SampleStockBook 
where (BookKind in (1)) and (IsNull(OutQty,0)=0) Group by  SampleInOutKindID,FabricID,CustomerID,SampleKindID,SalerID
UNION all
select SampleInOutKindID,FabricID,CustomerID,SampleKindID,SalerID,sum(InQty) as InQty ,sum(OutQty) as OutQty,sum(Price) as Amount
 from SampleStockBook 
where  (BookKind not in (1) Or (BookKind in (2) and (IsNull(OutQty,0)<>0)))

 ) a GROUP BY SampleInOutKindID,FabricID,CustomerID,SampleKindID,SalerID)TmpStockBOOK
 left join (select FabricID as FabID,Spec,Structure,ColorID,Place,StockUnit from p_Fabric)Fabric on

left join (select Code as CodeType,Name as NameType from p_FieldValid  where FieldType='SampleKind')FieldValid on 
TmpStockBOOK.SampleKindID=FieldValid.CodeType
Group by IsNull(FabricID,''), IsNull(Spec,'') , IsNull(Structure,''),

IsNull(Place,'')

ISNULL(StuffID,'') AS StuffID ,

ISNULL(SUM(InQty - OutQty),0) AS Qty

StuffID,
ISNULL(LotNo,'')LotNo, 
InQty, 0 AS OutQty
FROM   dye.StuffStockBook
WHERE (BookKind IN (11, 13, 14, 15,16, 19,33)) --AND ( ISNULL(OutQty, 0) = 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT
ISNULL(b.WareHouseID,'')WareHouseID,
StuffID,ISNULL(LotNo,'')LotNo, 
0 AS InQty,
Qty AS OutQty
FROM
dye.StuffOutDetail a 
JOIN dye.StuffOut b ON a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries  
WHERE  ISNULL(Qty, 0) > 0
)x
GROUP BY WareHouseID,StuffID,LotNo
